name: language-rooted-fqn-scheme
body: The FQN scheme, prose-only (validated structurally, satisfaction by review): module = `<language-id>.<module-identity>`; a declaration whose parent is a module renders `<rooted-module>.<name>`; nested members inherit through the rooted ancestor; overload groups keep the erased `(<params>)` suffix, Go `init` keeps `.init#<file-basename>`, TS getter/setter stay overloads. `<language-id>` is the `lang_switch` id verbatim (`go`/`java`/`cpp`/`rust`/`ts`/`js`/`csharp`/`py`/`md`) — the same string as domain.value.language-id and the `Language` node's FQN root. This scheme supersedes every bare module FQN form; files and `UnresolvedTarget`s are not language-rooted (a File FQN stays its absolute path, a foreign symbol name stays verbatim).
